title: Showcase manifest.json (CT-8)
description: A showcase: frames of one detector at one position, with the stamps in binary files beside the manifest.

pairs.description: Matched pairs, as positions in frames, the earlier visit first.

stamps.description: Little-endian float32: frames in order, each w*h values row by row, first row at the lowest y.

flags.description: Little-endian int32 in the same layout, or null.

refs.description: Sources for what the showcase shows.

numbers.description: Keys of numbers.json that belong to the showcase.

grid.description: What the stamps are drawn on; "detector" when absent. "north-up" is the display grid: north up, east to the left, 6.15 arcsec per pixel, centred on the target, nearest neighbour; each frame then has sky.

cd.description: [east per x, east per y, north per x, north per y], degrees per pixel.

lam.description: Wavelength at the target pixel, um.

bw.description: Bandwidth at the target pixel, um.

x0.description: Full-frame pixel x of the first element.

y0.description: Full-frame pixel y of the first element.

tx.description: The target's x in stamp pixels.

ty.description: The target's y in stamp pixels.

visit.description: 0 for the earliest visit, counting up in time.

sky.description: The sky around the target pixel of the stamp as written.
